name: 谋鲁肃

officialSkillTexts.明势: 摸牌阶段，你可多摸2张牌，然后展示3张手牌并令一名其他角色获得其中1张，若你手牌数不为全场最多，你再摸2张牌。
officialSkillTexts.盟谋: 转换技，游戏开始时可自选阴阳状态，每回合各限一次，当你获得其他角色的牌或其他角色获得你的牌后，你可以令该角色阳：使用X张【杀】，每造成1点伤害你与其回复1点体力；阴：打出X张【杀】，每少打出1张其失去1点体力。（X为你的体力上限）

versionSelection: Use the current hero1631 text for Mingshi: 多摸2 adds2 to native normal Draw. The formal6.4.0 body writes 可摸2张牌 without 改为 and does not explicitly replace normal Draw. Selecting the current printed body and its additive native mapping is a project engineering interpretation, not a user adjudication or an official FAQ. Current and formal Mengmou agree; historical hand-only sources, HP-based X and actor-only recovery are superseded.
engineeringMappings: Mingshi accepts an exact actual Draw-phase ticket, adjusts that native normal Draw by2, and continues after the genuine normal draw. The owner selects3 actual Hand entities and the other recipient; the recipient chooses1 from the publicly shown entities, following the existing native public Hand draft contract in GameEngine.NamedDefenseAndPublicDraft.cs. Remaining cards stay publicly shown while this choice owns them. This control mapping is engineering reuse, not an attributed official FAQ.

Compare current Hand counts only after the actual chosen gift and its movement children, including any Mengmou, finish. Draw2 through the native draw producer only if another living role then has strictly more Hand cards; a tie for most satisfies most.

Mengmou uses actual ToHand acquisitions involving the owner and another role, from every location that actually has an OwnerSeat, including Equipment, Judgment and owned piles. An equipment placement is not invented as a Hand acquisition. Processing has no owner: attribute it only through the immediately preceding owned entry plus an exact typed native transfer invoice (including genuine Snatch or an issued typed transfer). Do not attribute a plain discarded-card acquisition to an old owner.

Choose opening Yin or Yang through the owning GameStarting frame. Each direction has its own accepted-use budget in the actual turn. Acceptance toggles the public direction and freezes X from maximum HP, without charging a card payment or mixing earlier-turn counters.

Yang requests genuine native Slash Uses from the affected role, preserving current material/conversion, legal targets, distance, prohibitions, response, damage, death and typed whole-use returns. The exact issued request receives its own quota acceptance and debit exemption, never a global Slash bonus. Each actual damage point caused by one of those exact Uses resolves native Recover1 for Lu Su then native Recover1 for the actor before proceeding. This already accepted obligation uses the exact currently live issued Use/action, original source instance/hash and actual descendant Damage frame even after its original grant is lost; it never reconstructs a new entitlement from unrelated history and cannot reward the same Damage twice.

Yin requests genuine Played Slash Responses, preserving current legal single/multi-card conversion and payment. It never creates a CardUseFrame or CardUse declaration. Native Response Accepted observers finish, physical costs really enter Discard with ResponseFinished, movement children drain, then native Response Completed observers return through the exact owning typed receipt. Only that completion increases the Played count. Each missing response causes native LoseHp1, retaining health/dying child returns and avoiding repeated payment on resume.

All shown entities, selected native action/materials, original responder, accepted Response action, movement disposal, frozen X, branch cursor, draw and health continuation remain on immutable owning frames and use the existing checkpoint and content-hash guards. No rules epoch, package version, save schema or alternate pending object is introduced.
